string.text: {=str_tor_str_key_description.TORGameKeyContext_AbilitySelectionMenu}1) During battle pressing Q puts you into aiming mode, a reticule will appear and you will be able to target your spells. Aiming mode is accompanied by a visual animation on your character.{newline}2) Using the mouse wheel will switch between your spells (if you have learned multiple){newline}3) New UI elements will appear on the bottom left of your screen, with an image representing your selected spell and its cooldown time. {newline}4) Spells are reliant on the user's Winds of Magic (mana). It is regained over time on the campaign map.

{=str_tor_str_key_description.TORGameKeyContext_QuickCast}Cast spells or prayers without needing to switch to spell cast mode. Warning: There is no target indication and the Spells follow predefined casting order. For targeted casting, always use the Spellcaster mode.
{=str_tor_str_key_description.TORGameKeyContext_CareerAbilityCast}Starting Career ability, like the mistform for the Vampire Counts, or Knightly strike of the Grailknight
